description: Dependency rules of the TULPAR agent, checked by tools/check_static.py. Sources: RSD v1.1 Section 2.3, Table 4.25 (internal interfaces) and Table 5.1 (MD1, MD5, MD9, MD14, MD19). Modules exchange data only through the interfaces of Table 4.25, which the agent root wires together; a module never includes another module's headers, except the services of M-CRY (I6). Botan (third_party) is reachable only from M-CRY (RSD-CRY-01e).

rule_ids.harness: MD9 / RSD-SIM-02a: agent code must not reach the simulation harness or the ground truth
rule_ids.lsc: MD19: the LSC links no agent module and no record decoder
rule_ids.sec_motion: MD5: security has only need and state interfaces to mission
rule_ids.module: RSD Table 4.25: modules exchange data only through the agent root's wiring and M-CRY services
rule_ids.wall_clock: RSD-SIM-01a: no wall-clock call is reachable from agent code
rule_ids.mesh_core: RSD-NET-01a: the mesh core target has no transport dependencies
rule_ids.routing: RSD-NET-01a: overlay frames go through UDP sockets and no ns-3 routing protocol is installed
